integrity.proof_basis: Exact finite-state balance equations and the multi-affine real-stability criterion; accompanying symbolic checker.

scientific_limitations: The strong-Rayleigh equivalence is proved only for the first three occupied-site indicators, not every longer chain at low input ratio.
At high input ratio the three-site marginal obstructs stability for all longer chains, without claiming an exact longer-chain threshold.
The positive outer-site correlation refers to a positive external-field reweighting, not to the original unweighted dynamics.
The original 2011 article full text was not accessible for complete inspection; its abstract and later primary analyses were compared.
title: Sharp real-stability threshold and latent positive correlations in a batch-coalescing lattice
